content.text:
Fullscreen now sizes to the viewport rather than the document, in both places it went wrong:

**Inside the editor app**
- [app.css](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/app.css#L221): the fullscreen pane is `overflow: hidden`, the root/body scroll is locked while it's open (`html:has(.preview-pane.-fullscreen)`), and `#preview` flexes to fill the pane with its own internal scroll.
- [main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L621): `resizePreviewFrame()` drops the inline content height while fullscreen, so the frame can't grow past the pane; exiting restores content-height sizing.

**Embedded in the docs page** (the taller-than-viewport iframe you described)
- [canvas-rce-iframe-height.js](docs/scripts/canvas-rce-iframe-height.js#L30) now reports a `fullscreen` flag — true when TinyMCE adds `tox-fullscreen` or the preview pane is `-fullscreen` — and re-posts when only that flag changes.
- [CanvasRcePage.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CanvasRcePage.vue#L29) stops mirroring content height while that flag is set and pins the iframe `position: fixed; inset: 0`, so the `100vh` overlays inside resolve to the real viewport.

Added a changeset; regenerated the inlined scaffold templates. Worth a browser check of both toggles on the docs Canvas RCE page.

content.text:
Added a viewport-height floor to the embedded frame in [CanvasRcePage.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CanvasRcePage.vue#L55):

- `.canvas-rce-page__frame` now gets `min-height: calc(100vh - var(--vp-nav-height, 64px))`, so a short document no longer truncates the tray/overlays — it fills the space below the nav (763px at the current 827px viewport) while still growing with taller content.
- The `-fullscreen` rule resets `min-height: 0` so the pinned `position: fixed; inset: 0` overlay stays exactly viewport-sized.

Verified live on the page: at rest the frame is ≥ viewport-minus-nav with no clipping; toggling preview fullscreen pins it to `top: 0`, height 827, `document.scrollHeight === innerHeight` (no scrollbars); toggling back restores content-height sizing.
